name: D major in DADGAD — frets 0–12
tuning: D A D G A D
description: Three strings are tuned to D and two to A, so roots and 5ths are everywhere — including all the open strings.

name: D major in drop D — frets 0–12
tuning: D A D G B E
description: Only string 6 changes: every note on it is two frets higher than in standard tuning, and its open string is now the root.

name: G major triad in open G — frets 0–12
tuning: D G D G B D
description: Open G: every string is a note of the G chord, so a straight barre at any fret is a major chord.
